Our Story

Crafting Quality
Since 1970

Earwadi Timbers & Sawmill has been a cornerstone of quality timber and building materials in Padalur for over three decades. Founded in 1970, we supply timber, custom doors, steel, and roofing solutions for homes and industries across Perambalur district.

All types of wood processed with precision machinery
Custom-sized doors crafted to your exact specifications
Complete range of hardware & construction materials
Direct mill pricing — no middlemen, maximum value
Serving Padalur, Alathur & Perambalur for 35+ years
